}}'''Burin Shaeren''' is a [[Warder]] who is [[Bonding|bonded]] to [[Lelaine Akashi]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Burin Shaeren}}

== Appearance ==
He is [[Domani]], with a typical coppery skin and stumpy.

== History ==
He has been her Warder for more than twenty years.

== Activities ==
While in Salidar, he is seen by [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] watching over [[Logain]], as he speaks to nobles about being set up as a false dragon by the [[Red Ajah]].

He is with Lelaine, when she asks [[Siuan Sanche]] to pledge her support behind her if [[Egwene al'Vere]] is executed.

He is guarding [[Romanda Cassin]]'s tent when cockroaches begin to pour into the tent.
